about: The Auto-Fixer Test Bench seed: one card per open PR in real-raven575/auto-fix_Win10-11, each step marked 👤 human or 🤖 robot. Copied 2026-11-14 16:3x UTC from 🐒 Wrench's prototype (FIXW-0032). Names and steps only; results raven575 records stay on the lab server.
title: Auto-Fixer Test Bench
intro: Every open Auto-Fixer PR and what still needs testing. 👤 steps are yours; 🤖 steps a Claude robot runs and fills in.

items.title: #29 Window parts 2 and 3: findings, dialog, Repair, Clean up, Printers

steps.text: Download the branch zip from PR #29 and unzip it.
Double-click AutoFix-GUI.bat and answer Yes at the Windows prompt.
The window opens and the status bar says Administrator: Yes.
Load check on BEASTLY with screenshots of the new pages (fresh %TEMP% folder, deleted after).
steps.robot: PART DONE: on BEASTLY the module loads (ModuleVersion 1.3.3, 14 commands). CI is green on both shells (2026-11-13 15:12 UTC). Screenshots not taken yet; Pester can't run on BEASTLY (Pester 3.4.0 only).

steps.text: Run DISM CheckHealth (read-only). No dialog appears and it finishes OK.
Run SFC scan. The "Are you sure?" dialog lists the step, Admin, Internet and Time; the restore-point box is ticked.
Keys: N and Esc close the dialog with "Nothing was changed". Y starts the scan.
SFC finishes. The outcome says whether a restart is needed; the PC never restarts by itself.
Measure what can be removed. Grouped tick boxes appear; locked items can't be ticked.
Tick Recycle Bin. The dialog warns that removed files can't be put back.
Remove the ticked items. The outcome says how much was freed.
Optimize one SSD. The dialog says TRIM and it finishes OK.
Pick a saved scan. The summary shows.
Expand a finding: explanation, fixes and log entries show.
Open in browser opens the report.
The page shows the spooler summary, What we suggest, and a card per printer.
Print a test page. The dialog asks first, and the page prints.
Make default on a printer, with the "stop Windows from changing it" box ticked.
Back to Printers runs the check again and shows "Last fix: ...".
Clear all print jobs asks twice. No on the second ask changes nothing.
Connect by name with a wrong path (such as abc) says it is not a \\server\printer path.
Printer names stay redacted until Show sensitive data is on in Settings.
Start SFC, then switch to Home, Findings and Settings while it runs.
The status bar names the run and the taskbar button shows progress.
Clicking Repair, Clean up or Printers during the run goes back to the running task.
Closing the window during a run warns first.
Mode = Technician: printer cards get Remove, the spooler card gets recovery.
Remove duplicate copies: the keep box starts on the suggested copy; only the others go.
Find unused drivers lists only non-built-in drivers; removing one offers a restore point.
Give the merge yes. Claude bumps the version to main +1, checks CI, then merges.

items.title: #39 Redaction: built-in words, \\server\share, one-shot unredacted save
items.area: Draft · its own thread runs the 🤖 steps

steps.text: Pester (Redaction, Menu, Printers, Launcher) on Windows PowerShell 5.1: all pass.
-NoMenu -SaveSensitive with input redirected: refused ("needs a person at the keyboard"); scan .json has "redacted": true.
Search that scan's .json and .html for the PC name and user name: not found.
Console: Settings > Save reports without redaction > Y, then Scan > Y. Says "This report only...", report NOT redacted, switch now Off.
Scan again right after: no "Are you sure?"; report redacted.
Turn the switch on again, Scan > N: report redacted, switch stays On.
Window: tick Save reports without redaction > Yes, Scan > Yes. Activity says "This report only..."; box unticked after.
Printers > A > N, type a \\server\printer path not installed (fails safely), redaction on: screen and log show \\<...>\<...> only.
Repair step or scan with redaction on, open its log: "System Restore" and "Settings > System" read normally.
Scan with redaction on: PC name and user name still hidden.

items.title: #38 Repair log: stale next steps, pending restarts, always end the log
items.area: Draft · its own thread is on BEASTLY now

steps.text: Download the branch to a new %TEMP% folder, elevated PowerShell 5.1.
Pester SystemFiles, Collectors, DismSource: all pass.
Test-AfRestartPending matches the registry flags.
Repair > K: log has "[1/1]" and "Started" before "Expected", ends with "Run end" and "Total".
Repair > N then Ctrl+C: log ends with "Stopped : ... step 1 of 1 (DISM ScanHealth)" and "Run end".
RREQZX (store damaged) scan: High finding "Corrupt system files" listed again.
PC waiting for a restart: Repair > K asks "Restart Windows first?"; N runs the step and the log records the Q and A.
Same PC, Repair > S: whole SFC pending sentence in the log, FAILED, restart next step.
If C fails with 0x800F0806: plain meaning, restart next step, restart offered at the end.
"Repairable" PC, Run all: no stale "Next: R, then S" line when R and S finish OK.
Run all in Technician, close with X during step 1: log ends on that step's "Started" line (expected).
RREQZX Run all: if RestoreHealth fails, DISM's own reason shows, then "Run the remaining steps anyway?".
Update the old 1.2.0 copy on RREQZX; repair log header shows the new version.

items.title: #37 GUI launcher: one hop, no hidden window, stop in background sessions

steps.text: Double-click AutoFix-GUI.bat as a normal user: one black window, a key press, one UAC prompt, then the window. Console minimized; nothing flashes.
Say No at UAC: "Continuing without administrator rights", window opens unelevated.
From an elevated cmd: no UAC prompt, window opens.
Run as SYSTEM: "cannot open in a background or SYSTEM session", exit code 2, no window.
If a security product is present, note whether it still alerts.

items.title: #34 Reorder the menus for a fix-it flow

steps.text: Fresh %TEMP% download, Pester and the linter: all green, same as CI.
steps.robot: PASS via CI: Pester + lint green on both shells (2026-11-12 19:59 UTC). On BEASTLY the tests can't run: it has only Pester 3.4.0 (tests need 5.5+) and no PSScriptAnalyzer. Nothing was installed.

steps.text: AutoFix.bat, Standard, main menu: 1 Scan, 2 Report, 3 Repair | 4 Network, 5 Office, 6 Clean up | 7 Logs, 8 Settings, 9 About, Quit visible.
Press 2, then 3: 2 opens Reports, 3 opens Repair.
Repair menu: Run all | CheckHealth, ScanHealth, DISM version | SFC, RestoreHealth, ComponentCleanup | Back, Quit.
Network and domain in Standard: Network tools, Clear saved drive passwords | Back, Quit; summary above.
Technician Network and domain: W, C | D S T J U L A P | Back, Quit; Quit visible, no summary.
Technician Network tools: Status, Ping, DNS, Trace, Port, Netstat | Flush, Release/renew, Restart adapter, Reset Winsock / TCP/IP | Back, Quit; tags inside the border.
Standard Network tools: one short line on top, Quit visible.
Settings: Mode, Screen style | Go online | Show sensitive, Save without redaction | Back, Quit.
Press each letter you know: same item as before; only numbers moved.
Repeat main menu and Technician Network with -Plain: same order, plain lines.

items.title: #27 Explain [ADMIN]/[CHG] tags; offer Online after Technician opt-in

steps.text: Main menu: the line above the keys reads [ADMIN] ... [CHG] .... Settings has no tag line.
Run with -Plain, then with NO_COLOR: same line (Ascii above the hint).
Delete settings.json, start, pick Technician, Y: Online tip appears. N leaves Online: Off.
Repeat with Y: Settings shows Online: On.
Switch to Standard, then Technician again with Online on: no Online question.
Window: repeat the settings.json and switch-back steps in the GUI.
Load check on BEASTLY: menu legend line renders in Branded, Plain and Ascii (read-only).
steps.robot: NOT RUN YET: Screen and Menu tests need Pester 5.5+ and BEASTLY has 3.4.0. CI is green on both shells (2026-11-11 05:18 UTC), and that run includes the legend tests.

items.title: #21 Online add-ons, Back up PSTs, Purview PST Import, Remove or install Office
items.area: Draft · on hold for IMPORT access

steps.text: Back up PSTs, default folder: plan, free-space check, Y/N; copies in C:\PSTBackup-date, SHA-256 matches.
Back up to a drive with too little space: stops and says how much is needed.
PST named after a person or company: masked on screen and in the log.
Retire an old profile in Standard: not offered.
Retire, Technician, default profile: refused with a plain reason.
Retire, old profile, N: nothing changed.
Retire, Y: restore point, registry export, profile renamed .old, Outlook opens fine.
Undo the retire: profile back, Outlook can pick it.
Purview item in Standard: not shown.
Purview item in Technician: warning first, no network call (Resource Monitor), backup + hash list, then steps.
Any step, then the Runs log: matches the screen; exit codes explained.
Test run: backup made, removal plan listed, nothing removed.
Remove: asks twice, backup first, Teams still works after.
Install from a mounted ISO after Y/N.
Licence status reads from OSPP.VBS; no key is shown or logged.
CI green on both shells (lint clean, Pester passes).
